source_provenance_limits: No bit-for-bit compiler rebuild is claimed.
The python-flint upstream scripts name GMP6.3.0, MPFR4.2.2 and FLINT3.6.0 and include the Windows GMP C23 patch.

MSYS2 recipe snapshot is from the last winpthreads recipe commit before wheel upload; GCC16.1.0 revision5 matches the native binary compiler string. The precise winpthreads build revision is not asserted from the recipe snapshot alone.
NumPy is a local patched build, not an official-wheel byte match.
SciPy and its OpenBLAS are retained binaries; the supplied SciPy source tarball is not claimed to reproduce the OpenBLAS binary byte for byte.
